results.sql:
SELECT
  l.l_orderkey,
  l.l_linenumber,
  l.l_extendedprice,
  AVG(l.l_extendedprice) OVER (PARTITION BY l.l_orderkey) AS order_avg_extendedprice
FROM
  lineitem l
JOIN
  orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE
  l.l_shipmode = 'AIR'
  AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate <= '1997-12-31'
  AND l.l_extendedprice > AVG(l.l_extendedprice) OVER (PARTITION BY l.l_orderkey)
ORDER BY
  l.l_orderkey ASC,
  l.l_linenumber ASC

            LAG(total_revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY order_year, order_month)) * 100,

SELECT
    p.p_brand,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_net_revenue
FROM
    orders o
JOIN
    customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN
    nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN
    region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN
    lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN
    part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE
    o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1992-01-01' AND '1992-12-31'
    AND r.r_name = 'ASIA'
GROUP BY
    p.p_brand
HAVING
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 500000.00
ORDER BY
    total_net_revenue DESC

WITH total_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_mktsegment,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_rev
    FROM customer c
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1998-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate <= '1998-12-31'
    GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment
),
brand_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_mktsegment,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS brand_rev
    FROM customer c
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1998-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate <= '1998-12-31'
      AND p.p_brand = 'Brand#35'
    GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment
)
SELECT
    tr.c_mktsegment AS market_segment,
    ROUND(COALESCE(br.brand_rev, 0) * 100.0 / tr.total_rev, 2) AS revenue_percentage
FROM total_revenue tr
LEFT JOIN brand_revenue br ON tr.c_mktsegment = br.c_mktsegment
WHERE tr.total_rev > 0
ORDER BY revenue_percentage DESC, market_segment ASC

    n.n_name AS nation_name,
    SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity
FROM
    part p
JOIN
    partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN
    nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN
    region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE
    p.p_brand = 'Brand#23'
    AND r.r_name = 'AFRICA'
GROUP BY
    n.n_name
HAVING
    SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 500
ORDER BY
    total_available_quantity DESC,
    nation_name ASC

SELECT
    o_orderpriority,
    o_clerk,
    total_line_items,
    clerk_rank
FROM (
    SELECT
        o.o_orderpriority,
        o.o_clerk,
        COUNT(*) AS total_line_items,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority
            ORDER BY total_line_items DESC, o.o_clerk ASC
        ) AS clerk_rank
    FROM orders o
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    WHERE l.l_shipmode = 'AIR'
      AND o.o_orderdate >= '1998-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate <= '1998-12-31'
    GROUP BY o.o_orderpriority, o.o_clerk
) AS ranked
ORDER BY o_orderpriority ASC, clerk_rank ASC

ORDER BY c_acctbal DESC, c_name ASC

SELECT
    c.c_mktsegment AS market_segment,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_gross_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS distinct_supplier_count
FROM lineitem l
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA'
    AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) = 1994
GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment
ORDER BY total_gross_revenue DESC, market_segment ASC

    o.o_orderpriority AS order_priority,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_net_revenue,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS distinct_order_count
FROM
    customer c
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
WHERE
    c.c_mktsegment = 'HOUSEHOLD'
    AND l.l_shipmode = 'REG AIR'
    AND o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate <= '1996-12-31'
GROUP BY
    o.o_orderpriority
ORDER BY
    total_net_revenue DESC,
    order_priority ASC

GROUP BY

ORDER BY
    total_net_revenue DESC,
    c.c_mktsegment ASC

SELECT
    n.n_name AS n_name,
    ROUND(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_shipmode = 'FOB' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) /
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)),
        2
    ) AS fob_percentage
FROM
    nation n
JOIN
    region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN
    customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
JOIN
    orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
JOIN
    lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
WHERE
    r.r_name = 'EUROPE'
    AND c.c_mktsegment = 'MACHINERY'
    AND o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate <= '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY
    n.n_name
ORDER BY
    fob_percentage DESC,
    n_name ASC

JOIN nation n ON ss.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
GROUP BY n.n_name

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_custkey,
        SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_spending
    FROM customer c
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
    WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'FURNITURE'
      AND o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01'
      AND o.o_orderdate <= '1995-12-31'
      AND p.p_container = 'JUMBO BOX'
    GROUP BY c.c_custkey
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN total_spending >= 10000 THEN '10000+'
        WHEN total_spending >= 5000 THEN '5000-10000'
        ELSE '0-5000'
    END AS spending_bucket,
    CASE
        WHEN total_spending >= 10000 THEN 10000
        WHEN total_spending >= 5000 THEN 5000
        ELSE 0
    END AS bucket_min,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customer_spending
GROUP BY spending_bucket, bucket_min
ORDER BY bucket_min ASC

SELECT
    l_orderkey,
    l_linenumber,
    p_name,
    l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS net_revenue
FROM
    lineitem
JOIN
    part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey
WHERE
    l_shipmode = 'FOB'
    AND p_container = 'LG DRUM'
    AND l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) = (
        SELECT MAX(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount))
        FROM
            lineitem
        JOIN
            part ON lineitem.l_partkey = part.p_partkey
        WHERE
            l_shipmode = 'FOB'
            AND p_container = 'LG DRUM'
    )
ORDER BY
    l_orderkey ASC,
    l_linenumber ASC

SELECT
    s.s_name,
    n.n_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(l.l_extendedprice), 0) AS total_revenue
FROM
    supplier s
JOIN
    nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN

SELECT

    SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'N' THEN l.l_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS kept_revenue,
    SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS returned_revenue
FROM
    orders o
JOIN
    customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN
    lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
WHERE
    o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate <= '1995-12-31'
    AND o.o_orderpriority = '3-MEDIUM'
GROUP BY
    c.c_mktsegment
HAVING
    kept_revenue + returned_revenue > 0
ORDER BY
    market_segment ASC

WITH filtered_lineitems AS (
    SELECT
        l_orderkey,
        l_linenumber,
        l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS net_revenue
    FROM lineitem
    WHERE
        l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01'
        AND l_shipdate <= '1995-12-31'
        AND l_shipmode = 'REG AIR'
)
SELECT
    l_orderkey,
    l_linenumber,
    net_revenue
FROM
    filtered_lineitems
WHERE
    net_revenue = (SELECT MAX(net_revenue) FROM filtered_lineitems)
ORDER BY
    net_revenue DESC

WITH revenue_calc AS (
    SELECT
        c.c_mktsegment AS market_segment,
        n.n_name AS nation_name,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    WHERE o.o_orderpriority = '1-URGENT'
    GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment, n.n_name
)
SELECT
    market_segment,
    nation_name,
    ROUND(total_revenue, 2) AS total_revenue,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY market_segment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank
FROM revenue_calc
ORDER BY market_segment ASC, revenue_rank ASC

    c_name,

    GROUP BY l.l_suppkey
) AS sub
ON s.s_suppkey = sub.l_suppkey
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
GROUP BY n.n_name
ORDER BY avg_supplier_revenue DESC, n.n_name ASC
